scene.head: with_body
scene.placeText: a little gilded bandstand in a moonlit ballroom of pale stone and mirrors in her world's river capital at midnight — couples gliding counter-clockwise in close embrace across the polished floor before her, tall windows open onto the silver river and silver spirit lights drifting like jacaranda petals
scene.ownProp: a small ornate bandoneon of black lacquer inlaid with mother-of-pearl, its pleated bellows half drawn open between her hands
scene.outfit: a milonga-witch look fitted to her body — a close-fitting strapless dark silk dress with a thigh-high slit, wine-red and black veil sashes pleated like bandoneon bellows wound about her hips and trailing, a silver comb crowned with violet jacaranda blossom and strappy satin heels
scene.scene: she is the bandoneon witch of the midnight milonga, seated sideways on a low velvet stool on the bandstand, drawing her bandoneon's pleated bellows open and closed with both hands, and with every slow breath of its music the dancers' shadows glide and turn across the floor
